docs.text: Testing and CI ¶ How the driver is checked: host tests against an independent model of the sensor for every part, fault injection, a fuzzer that corrupts what the sensor sends back, compiled documentation, compile-fail tests, an install test, ESP32 and Cortex-M builds, static analysis and measured quality gates, on every pull request. No hardware yet Everything on this page runs against a model of the sensor. The model is written from the same documents as the driver, so a misreading shows up in both. What is not verified lists what only a bench can settle. Host tests ¶ The tests build the real driver against a model of the sensor, with the firmware's flags, -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti -Wswitch-enum -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion , and warnings as errors, on GCC and Clang. cmake -S . -B build -DSFM_FLOW_METER_BUILD_TESTS = ON cmake --build build ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure File Covers tests/test_all_parts.cpp Every one of the 32 variants through the whole life cycle: identify, scaling, start, sample, stop, reset tests/test_parts.cpp The table against hand-typed datasheet expectations, Validate() , presets, CheckedConfig , the CRC vectors of both initial values tests/test_sf06.cpp SF06: framing, commands, mixtures, concentration updates, averaging, status checks, sleep and wake, a sensor that NACKs between samples (N = 1 and N = 128 stay Measuring , with and without a clock, 20000 tight reads), device loss only after the silence bound, rejected frames and raw reads keep the silence clock running, no escalation without a clock, the stop time after a reported reset, start-up from a sleeping sensor, NACKed polls are not bus errors, the identifier poll option, no empty write, no soft reset in sleep, stuck lines tests/test_gen2_dual.cpp SFM3304 (filter argument, status layout) and SFM3505 (24-bit frame, two flows) tests/test_sf05.cpp Legacy pointer commands, EEPROM scale, first-byte rule, restart before read, temperature by pointer, the two-pointer serial number and the SFM3000 whose 0x31AF is refused, oxygen refused on the SFM3200 and SFM4200 and nitrogen at the air scale where listed, getters cleared after a failed call, the error limit leading to StateUnknown and a caller's HardReset() tests/test_sf04.cpp SFM4100: trigger bytes, stretching read, one gas per address tests/test_sfx.cpp SFM6000D: every [P] fact has a test that flips it tests/test_states.cpp The state machine: every call in every state, Busy , StateUnknown , Poll() tests/test_errors.cpp The base Error values are 0 to 9; every error value (16 and up) is returned by some call tests/test_kconfig.cpp KconfigDefaults() with and without CONFIG_ values tests/test_version.cpp The version getters follow the generated header (also against a 9.8.7 probe) tests/fuzz/ The fuzz target; CTest replays its corpus, see below tests/compile_fail/ Eight pieces of code that must not compile, each for its EXPECT: diagnostic: a class that is not a port, a hook without noexcept , a port without DelayUs() in a blocking call, an invalid CheckedConfig , an SFM4100 object without ReadStretch() , a PowerCycle() returning void , a bad family mask, an enumeration whose last-enumerator trait is missing tests/docs/ Every C++ block of the documentation, compiled (target sfm_flow_meter_doc_snippets ) examples/host/ The host example, built with the test flags and run ( sfm_flow_meter_host_example ) tests/check_install.cmake Installs into a scratch prefix and builds tests/install_consumer/ with find_package(sfm_flow_meter) tests/check_doxygen.cmake Doxygen with _config/Doxyfile and warnings as errors, when doxygen is installed The model ¶ tests/model_sfm.hpp is a sensor written as a behaviour, not as a copy of the driver: a Chip that takes a transaction at the bus, decodes it as the datasheet describes, enforces the timing (the first sample after a start, the reset and wake times, the half millisecond of the SF05 restart), and keeps a log of every transaction. It can NACK reads between samples ( no_new_sample , one result every N x 0.5 ms), counts empty writes and commands the datasheet forbids in the mode (a soft reset in sleep), and accepts a wake on any write that reaches its address. It keeps its own clock of the last frame it delivered ( last_served_us ) and can refuse the second serial pointer ( no_serial_low ). tests/datasheet_expect.hpp holds the expectations of each variant typed by hand from the documents (address, scale, offset, span, timing, product identifier), so the table in the driver is compared with a second copy and not with itself. The model is independent in the way that counts for a typo: it does not include the driver's register or type headers for its constants. It is not independent of the documents. Part of its typing was derived from the table and the design notes, so a misreading of a document appears in both. That is the honest limit of testing without a bench, and every ambiguity that rests on it has a knob ( Contract ). Faults the model injects, one knob each: a failed write or read in turn (the nth transfer), a flipped byte of a read, a stuck line (all zeros or all ones), a bad status nibble or status XOR, a wrong scale, unit, product identifier or serial, a sensor that ignores a stop, a sensor that is gone ( dead ), a strict-restart mode, and a bus address different from the configured one. Fuzz tests ¶ Everything the driver reads comes from the sensor over the bus, so the data read is what a noisy cable, a wrong part or a broken sensor controls. tests/fuzz/fuzz_sfm_flow_meter.cpp lets libFuzzer choose a part, a configuration and a sequence of calls; between the calls it changes the sensor: fails a transfer, flips a bit, sticks the line, reports another product identifier or status, resets the sensor under the driver, changes the scale it reports and advances the clock. After every call it checks 17 invariants and aborts, naming the line, when one breaks: a failed call returns an Error the enumeration defines; a failed ReadSample() returns a zero Sample ; a call that returns NotInitialized , Busy , InvalidArgument or Unsupported sent nothing ( StateUnknown can follow traffic: the SF05 error limit); a failed call leaves nothing pending; a returned wait is at most one second; every read has a whole number of three-byte words and at most 18 bytes; a returned flow lies inside the span plus the margin unless RangePolicy::Flag flagged it; ReadSample() succeeds only while Measuring ; Measuring is entered only by a successful StartMeasurement() that finished; a successful reset leaves the driver Uninitialized ; the counters never decrease; has_flow2 , has_status and has_temperature follow the part's capabilities; StateUnknown is left only by an initialisation (to Idle , or Uninitialized if it failed) or a reset; a read leaves Measuring only with DeviceReset or StateUnknown , never for "no new sample"; no write is ever empty and no command is sent that the datasheet forbids in the current mode; DeviceReset follows real silence: the model, with its own clock of the last frame it delivered (rejected frames included), has been quiet for at least the whole bound (first-result time, N x 0.5 ms with 10 %, 1 ms); a temperature the getter returns lies in the plausible band, -60 to +150 degC: a stuck bus is never data. docs.text: tests/model_sfm.hpp is a sensor written as a behaviour, not as a copy of the driver: a Chip that takes a transaction at the bus, decodes it as the datasheet describes, enforces the timing (the first sample after a start, the reset and wake times, the half millisecond of the SF05 restart), and keeps a log of every transaction. It can NACK reads between samples ( no_new_sample , one result every N x 0.5 ms), counts empty writes and commands the datasheet forbids in the mode (a soft reset in sleep), and accepts a wake on any write that reaches its address. It keeps its own clock of the last frame it delivered ( last_served_us ) and can refuse the second serial pointer ( no_serial_low ). tests/datasheet_expect.hpp holds the expectations of each variant typed by hand from the documents (address, scale, offset, span, timing, product identifier), so the table in the driver is compared with a second copy and not with itself. The model is independent in the way that counts for a typo: it does not include the driver's register or type headers for its constants. It is not independent of the documents. Part of its typing was derived from the table and the design notes, so a misreading of a document appears in both. That is the honest limit of testing without a bench, and every ambiguity that rests on it has a knob ( Contract ). Faults the model injects, one knob each: a failed write or read in turn (the nth transfer), a flipped byte of a read, a stuck line (all zeros or all ones), a bad status nibble or status XOR, a wrong scale, unit, product identifier or serial, a sensor that ignores a stop, a sensor that is gone ( dead ), a strict-restart mode, and a bus address different from the configured one.

docs.text: Troubleshooting ¶ Find the cause of an error or a wrong reading. The first line of every answer is the error name that the call returned ( sfm::ToString(error) gives it for logs). Datasheet sections this page relies on IRQn and start-up behaviour: Sensirion AG SFM4300 D1 1.0, 3.2 Sensor start-up and warm-up; 3.3 IRQn, p. 8 Start measurement, results and the NACK of a read without data: Sensirion AG SFM4300 D1 1.0, 4.3.1 Start continuous measurement, p. 10 Status word: Sensirion AG SFM4300 D1 1.0, 4.3.2 Read measurement results, Table 5, p. 11 CRC-8 of every word: Sensirion AG SFM4300 D1 1.0, 4.4 Checksum calculation, Table 14, p. 15 Product identifier and serial number: Sensirion AG SFM4300 D1 1.0, 4.3.9 Read product identifier, Table 13, p. 15 Sfx6000 frame, start codes and addresses (preliminary): Sensirion AG SFx6000 I2C 1.1, I2C interface reference (preliminary), p. 6 Legacy command set with pointer registers (Sf05): Sensirion AG SFM-05 not printed (vendor page: 10/2026), I2C functional description (commands, EEPROM, serial, CRC), p. 4 All of them, with the driver API for each: Datasheet map . By error ¶ Error Where you see it What to check NoDevice Initialisation, a poll, a write, a read after a long silence Nothing acknowledged the address. Check the supply (see the variant table : the SF05 parts need 5 V), SDA and SCL wiring and pull-ups, and the address: the SFM4300 has 0x2A to 0x2D by its ADDR pin, the other parts a fixed one. A sleeping sensor does not answer until woken DeviceIdMismatch Initialisation A sensor answered but it is not the configured part. Check Config::variant and address ; with Variant::Auto check that the part is in the configured family. A prototype (revision 8x) needs accept_prototype Bus Any write A write hook returned false : a NACK on a write, or a bus error. Check the pull-ups, the clock against the part's limit, and that the port sends a STOP Timeout Wake, reset, a stretched read The sensor did not answer in time. After Sleep() the wake can take up to 20 ms; a reset up to 100 ms on the SF05 parts. A sensor held in reset, or SCL held low, stays silent NoData ReadSample() Not a fault: no new sample yet. The SF06 parts make one every 0.5 ms; after an averaging of N, every N x 0.5 ms. Ask again later. After a silence longer than the datasheet bound the driver asks with a real command and returns DeviceReset or NoDevice DeviceReset ReadSample() No new sample for longer than the datasheet bound, and the sensor acknowledged the command the driver then sent: it was reset (a power dip, a general call from another device, a brown-out) or is now stopped. The driver is Idle ; start again. With IRQn wired, low after a start also means reset Crc A read A word failed its CRC and the whole transfer was dropped. Check SCL speed, wire length, noise and the pull-ups. A line stuck low or high gives this, not a value InvalidReply A read The CRC is valid but the reply cannot be sent by the sensor, for example an all-zero identifier. Check for a stuck bus or another device at the address StatusMismatch ReadSample() The status word does not say the measurement the driver started is running (wrong gas index or concentration). Stop and start again; on a bus with another master, check that nothing else sent a start command Stale ReadSample() The sample is inside the warm-up time ( require_settled ), smoothed ( reject_smoothed ) or older than max_age_us . Not a fault; the policy is yours OutOfRange ReadSample() The flow is beyond the part's span plus the margin. Check the installation and the gas; RangePolicy::Flag returns the value flagged DeviceFault StartMeasurement() , ReadScaling() The scale, offset or unit the sensor reports differs from the datasheet. A recalibrated part, a wrong variant, or a corrupted sensor. scaling_check chooses how strict to be StateUnknown After a failed command, or at the SF05 error limit The driver cannot know the sensor's mode. Call EnsureInitialized() (or SoftReset() first) Busy Any call An operation is pending (finish it with Poll() or AwaitPending() ), or the call is illegal in this mode: configuration only when idle, a read only while measuring, a wake only when asleep NotInitialized Any call EnsureInitialized() has not succeeded, or a reset or Deinitialize() ran since Unsupported A call The part, the port or the family mask does not offer the call: SoftReset() needs allow_general_call_reset and the port's WriteGeneralCall() ; HardReset() needs PowerCycle() or SetResetPin() ; Sleep() is for the SF06 parts and SFM3304 InvalidArgument A call, initialisation A Config field or argument is out of range; Validate(config) says so without touching the bus. Typical: an address outside the part's set, Auto with TimingPolicy::Datasheet , averaging on a part without it, an oxygen fraction above 1000 By symptom ¶ Symptom Likely cause A flow that is always 0 on an SFM4200 or SFM4100 An all-zero frame has a valid CRC there (I9 exception); check the bus level and GetStats() Flow reads too high or too low by a fixed factor The wrong gas: StartMeasurement(gas) selects the calibration. A mixture needs its oxygen fraction ( UpdateConcentration() ) The first samples are off The warm-up is 30 ms after a start (50 ms on the SFM3304 and SFM3505); use Sample::settled Readings stop after a while on an SF05 part A lock-up after an aborted read: the port must never abort a read early. At the error limit the driver is StateUnknown ; call HardReset() (the port's PowerCycle() , which must hold SDA and SCL low while the supply is off) and initialise again Another device on the bus resets SoftReset() is a general call and resets every device that listens. Leave allow_general_call_reset off when the bus is shared Two sensors at one address 0x2E is the SFM3019, SFM3304 and SFM3505; 0x40 is every SF05 part. Use the SFM4300's ADDR pin or separate buses Nothing on an SFM4100 It needs a clock-stretching read: the port needs ReadStretch() and a controller that tolerates a stretching slave An SFM3304 not found after the MCU reset It was asleep. Send the general call reset or cycle the supply, then initialise Counters ¶ GetStats() returns crc_errors , no_data , bus_errors , device_resets , consecutive_errors and power_cycles . A rising crc_errors with a clean bus_errors is a signal-integrity problem; a rising device_resets is a supply problem.

A sleeping sensor does not answer until woken DeviceIdMismatch Initialisation A sensor answered but it is not the configured part. Check Config::variant and address ; with Variant::Auto check that the part is in the configured family. A prototype (revision 8x) needs accept_prototype Bus Any write A write hook returned false : a NACK on a write, or a bus error. Check the pull-ups, the clock against the part's limit, and that the port sends a STOP Timeout Wake, reset, a stretched read The sensor did not answer in time. After Sleep() the wake can take up to 20 ms; a reset up to 100 ms on the SF05 parts. A sensor held in reset, or SCL held low, stays silent NoData ReadSample() Not a fault: no new sample yet. The SF06 parts make one every 0.5 ms; after an averaging of N, every N x 0.5 ms. Ask again later. After a silence longer than the datasheet bound the driver asks with a real command and returns DeviceReset or NoDevice DeviceReset ReadSample() No new sample for longer than the datasheet bound, and the sensor acknowledged the command the driver then sent: it was reset (a power dip, a general call from another device, a brown-out) or is now stopped. The driver is Idle ; start again. With IRQn wired, low after a start also means reset Crc A read A word failed its CRC and the whole transfer was dropped. Check SCL speed, wire length, noise and the pull-ups. A line stuck low or high gives this, not a value InvalidReply A read The CRC is valid but the reply cannot be sent by the sensor, for example an all-zero identifier. Check for a stuck bus or another device at the address StatusMismatch ReadSample() The status word does not say the measurement the driver started is running (wrong gas index or concentration). Stop and start again; on a bus with another master, check that nothing else sent a start command Stale ReadSample() The sample is inside the warm-up time ( require_settled ), smoothed ( reject_smoothed ) or older than max_age_us . Not a fault; the policy is yours OutOfRange ReadSample() The flow is beyond the part's span plus the margin. Check the installation and the gas; RangePolicy::Flag returns the value flagged DeviceFault StartMeasurement() , ReadScaling() The scale, offset or unit the sensor reports differs from the datasheet. A recalibrated part, a wrong variant, or a corrupted sensor. scaling_check chooses how strict to be StateUnknown After a failed command, or at the SF05 error limit The driver cannot know the sensor's mode. Call EnsureInitialized() (or SoftReset() first) Busy Any call An operation is pending (finish it with Poll() or AwaitPending() ), or the call is illegal in this mode: configuration only when idle, a read only while measuring, a wake only when asleep NotInitialized Any call EnsureInitialized() has not succeeded, or a reset or Deinitialize() ran since Unsupported A call The part, the port or the family mask does not offer the call: SoftReset() needs allow_general_call_reset and the port's WriteGeneralCall() ; HardReset() needs PowerCycle() or SetResetPin() ; Sleep() is for the SF06 parts and SFM3304 InvalidArgument A call, initialisation A Config field or argument is out of range; Validate(config) says so without touching the bus. Typical: an address outside the part's set, Auto with TimingPolicy::Datasheet , averaging on a part without it, an oxygen fraction above 1000

docs.text: Symptom Likely cause A flow that is always 0 on an SFM4200 or SFM4100 An all-zero frame has a valid CRC there (I9 exception); check the bus level and GetStats() Flow reads too high or too low by a fixed factor The wrong gas: StartMeasurement(gas) selects the calibration. A mixture needs its oxygen fraction ( UpdateConcentration() ) The first samples are off The warm-up is 30 ms after a start (50 ms on the SFM3304 and SFM3505); use Sample::settled Readings stop after a while on an SF05 part A lock-up after an aborted read: the port must never abort a read early. At the error limit the driver is StateUnknown ; call HardReset() (the port's PowerCycle() , which must hold SDA and SCL low while the supply is off) and initialise again Another device on the bus resets SoftReset() is a general call and resets every device that listens. Leave allow_general_call_reset off when the bus is shared Two sensors at one address 0x2E is the SFM3019, SFM3304 and SFM3505; 0x40 is every SF05 part. Use the SFM4300's ADDR pin or separate buses Nothing on an SFM4100 It needs a clock-stretching read: the port needs ReadStretch() and a controller that tolerates a stretching slave An SFM3304 not found after the MCU reset It was asleep. Send the general call reset or cycle the supply, then initialise

docs.text: GetStats() returns crc_errors , no_data , bus_errors , device_resets , consecutive_errors and power_cycles . A rising crc_errors with a clean bus_errors is a signal-integrity problem; a rising device_resets is a supply problem.
